name: cable 90 degrees internal rotation catch
description: A cable drill with the upper arm at shoulder height and elbow bent to 90 degrees. It trains the rotator cuff to catch and control a quick rotation.
instructions: Set the cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Raise your upper arm out to the side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
Let the cable pull your forearm back into external rotation.
Catch it, then rotate the forearm forward and down smoothly.
Keep your upper arm still and level.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.
